purpose: reserved forecast validation and Step-28 strategy freeze

annual_level.selection_rule: one coherent method across H1-H5; lowest reserved mean-horizon MAE, tie-break RMSE then absolute bias

dynamic_predictors.selection_rule: one coherent method per predictor across H1-H5; lowest reserved mean-horizon NMAE_SD, tie-break NRMSE_SD then absolute bias

future_feature_policy: Do not forecast engineered features independently. Step 28 must reconstruct lag/delta/history/interaction/neighbour features from the forecast base-predictor sequence using the original feature-engineering logic.
future_origin_policy: Step 28 operational forecasts use actual observed history through 2025 and generate H1-H5 for 2026-2030.
spatial_anomaly_model_policy: Use the existing frozen Step-22B production LightGBM trained on actual 2018-2025; do not retrain it on pseudo-future forecasts.
future_grid_lst_equation: future grid LST = forecast annual Kaduwela thermal level + centered Step-22B spatial-anomaly prediction
